meta.summary: Nothing new today. The full sweep (Meetup iCals, Luma calendars, foundercal, ushackathons, Cerebral Valley) reconfirmed the existing 90-day view — no new qualifying hackathons, build nights, demo nights or workshops surfaced. The only fresh Meetup finds were two AI Book Clubs from your AI Builders & Learners SF group (RLHF Nov 10, 'Illustrated Guide to AI Agents' Dec 22) — 1-hr discussion format, not added. New Luma/calendar listings this run were all talks, panels, dinners or GTM/sales (Private AI roundtable, GTM AI Paradox, Running Production with Agents, Mobile & AI meetup, paper-reading clubs) — not hands-on, not added. Reconfirmed the second Nov 1 'Breaking Models' Hacker Dojo session (Excessive Agency, 3–4:30pm) via its page after it dropped out of yesterday's iCal, and trimmed the 2:30pm session's end time to 4:00pm per the iCal. THIS WEEK (Oct 30–Nov 5): TODAY Oct 30 — Builder Base Buildathon (4/5, post-training/RL + fine-tune-your-own-model) + Night Hack IV @ Founders Inc (4/5) + A Halloween Hackathon+Party. Oct 31 — Haunted Hacks: Real-Time AI (YC) + STRANGER BUILDS Halloween hackathon (Frontier Tower) + Junfan Labs Maker Arm forum. Nov 1 — Breaking Models ×2 @ Hacker Dojo (2:30pm reproduce-&-fix + 3pm Excessive Agency, South Bay). Nov 2 — Fireworks w/ Microsoft & NVIDIA (4/5, open-model) + AgentCamp (Menlo Park) + OSA Con. Nov 3 — ⭐ Own Your AI Model Factory Hack Night (5/5, AWS Loft) + Decision Models Demo Night (Liquid AI) + TechEquity AI Summit begins. Nov 4 — Company Brain Hackathon (4/5, Menlo Park) + AI Startup Showcase. Nov 5 — Even Day SF (smart glasses build). Top 5/5 own-your-AI fits ahead remain Own Your AI Model Factory (Nov 3) and On-Device AI: Cleared for Takeoff (Nov 13).
